bath.gibbs_rule: tau=exp(-beta H)/Z; stable shift by the smallest source energy

energy_basis.population_quantization: probabilities retain binary64 source values; tiny Gibbs probabilities are not rounded to zero
energy_basis.rule: same-H eigh/evd ascending eigenvalues; largest-absolute component of each real eigenvector positive

joint.factor_recipe: for each thermal input b: sqrt(pi_b)(cI-is|b><b|)A plus compressed a!=b scatter row norms; rotate back from environment eigenbasis
joint.joint_spectrum_rule: eigenvalues of rho tensor tau, preserved by the emitted unitary W

preparation.interpretation: registered normalized one-electron Gram preparation; not the original 48-electron density or an identity PSD repair
preparation.rule: B = same-call native D(1+q); A=B/sqrt(Tr(B B.adjoint)); rho=A A.adjoint

thermodynamics.energy_unit: hartree per normalized prepared one-electron system

scope.collision_time_disposition: dimensionless integrated exchange gate; elapsed physical duration and interaction rate unmetered
scope.model: registered finite-level frozen-Hamiltonian thermal collision; same source native current
